notes: The excerpt begins mid-section: only the tail of the Drawing certificate's requirements table appears at the top of page 248 (CIS 082C, the Art Concentrated Electives list and 'Total Units 21'). The 'Electives' block name and its 'Select 3 units' rule are inferred from the parallel Painting, Printmaking and Sculpture certificates. Only CIS 082C, the last item of that list, is visible here. Those sibling certificates also list DDP 116 and BUMA 026 in this block.

The line 'Arts Entrepreneurship in Painting Certificate of Achievement' at the top of page 248 is read as a running page header, not as the heading of the courses below it. The Art Concentrated Electives list (figure drawing and drawing courses) and its position before the Painting section's own heading indicate these lines belong to the Drawing certificate.
The catalog prints ART 006A; the closed list stores it as ART006A, which is treated as the same course.
